## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## 💡 Problem Statement
**What problem would this feature solve?**
A clear description of the problem you're experiencing or the gap you've identified.

## 🎯 Proposed Solution
**How would you like this feature to work?**
Describe your ideal solution in detail.

## 🔄 User Story
**As a [type of user], I want [goal] so that [benefit].**
Example: "As a content moderator, I want bulk analysis capabilities so that I can process large amounts of content efficiently."

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups (optional)
If you have ideas for the user interface, please include mockups, sketches, or descriptions.

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
What conditions must be met for this feature to be considered complete?
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 🔀 Alternative Solutions
**What alternatives have you considered?**
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 Impact Assessment
**How many users would benefit from this feature?**
- [ ] All users
- [ ] Premium subscribers only
- [ ] Enterprise customers
- [ ] Developers/API users
- [ ] Specific user segment: ___________

## 🎯 Priority Level
**How important is this feature to you?**
- [ ] Critical - Blocks my primary use case
- [ ] High - Significantly improves my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have enhancement
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement

**Which platforms should this feature support?**

- [ ] Web application
- [ ] API/Backend
- [ ] Admin dashboard

## 🔗 Related Features
**Are there existing features this would integrate with?**
List any existing features or issues this relates to.

## 📚 Additional Context
Add any other context, research, or screenshots about the feature request here.

**Does this feature relate to content analysis?**
- Content Type: [text/image/video/audio/mixed]

- AI Enhancement: [accuracy/speed/new-capability]
